title: Appearance
subtitle: 「外觀／樣子／形象」，究竟是哪一種 appearance？
description: 「外觀／樣子／形象」，究竟是哪一種 appearance？

words.note: 最常見、最自然的近義詞之一。可指人、房間、產品、網站等「看起來的樣子」。
words.example: The new lighting changed the look of the room.
words.exampleZh: 新的燈光改變了房間的外觀。

exercises.original: The renovation completely changed the appearance of the café.
exercises.zh: 翻新工程完全改變了咖啡店的外觀。

options.explanation: 表示咖啡店整體看起來的樣子。

exercises.original: The new paint gives the room a brighter appearance.
exercises.zh: 新油漆令房間看起來更明亮。

options.explanation: a brighter look 是自然搭配。

exercises.original: The product has a more modern appearance than the old version.
exercises.zh: 這款產品比舊版本有更現代的外觀。

options.explanation: 最自然地表示產品外觀。

words.note: 通常用複數，特別常指人的外表和相貌。
words.example: People should not be judged only by their looks.
words.exampleZh: 不應只根據外貌判斷一個人。

exercises.original: She was often judged unfairly because of her appearance.
exercises.zh: 她常因外貌而受到不公平判斷。

options.explanation: 人的身體外貌最自然用 looks。

exercises.original: His youthful appearance made him seem younger than he was.
exercises.zh: 他年輕的外貌令他看起來比實際年齡小。

options.explanation: youthful looks 是很自然的搭配。

exercises.original: People should not be valued only for their appearance.
exercises.zh: 不應只根據外貌評價一個人。

words.note: 當 appearance 指一個人、公司、品牌或組織給外界的整體印象時，image 很接近。
words.example: The company redesigned its stores to create a more modern image.
words.exampleZh: 公司重新設計店舖，以建立更現代的形象。

exercises.original: The company changed its appearance to appeal to younger customers.
exercises.zh: 公司改變形象，以吸引較年輕的顧客。

options.explanation: 公司對外呈現的整體形象。

exercises.original: The politician worked hard to improve his public appearance.
exercises.zh: 這名政治人物努力改善自己的公眾形象。

exercises.original: The brand's appearance is intended to feel modern and trustworthy.
exercises.zh: 品牌形象旨在給人現代而可靠的感覺。

options.explanation: 品牌給外界的整體印象。

words.note: 強調從外面看得到的樣子，不談內在情況。
words.example: The building's outward appearance has changed very little.
words.exampleZh: 這座建築物的外觀幾乎沒有改變。

exercises.original: The building's appearance has changed very little over the years.
exercises.zh: 這座建築物多年來的外觀變化很少。

options.explanation: 強調從外面看到的外觀。

exercises.original: You cannot judge the quality of the product from its appearance alone.
exercises.zh: 不能只根據產品外表判斷其質素。

options.explanation: 突出「只看外表」而不是內在質素。

exercises.original: The redesign changed the appearance but not the internal structure.
exercises.zh: 重新設計改變了外觀，但沒有改變內部結構。

options.explanation: 和 internal structure 形成直接對比。

words.note: 較正式，強調物件或事物從外面看到的形狀、結構或形態。
words.example: The device has retained the outward form of the original model.
words.exampleZh: 這部裝置保留了原型的外在形態。

exercises.original: The new device keeps the appearance of the original model.
exercises.zh: 新裝置保留了原型的外形。

options.explanation: 較正式地表示外形與結構。

exercises.original: The sculpture's appearance is simple and geometric.
exercises.zh: 這件雕塑的外形簡單而幾何化。

exercises.original: The packaging changed in appearance but kept the same dimensions.
exercises.zh: 包裝的外形改變了，但尺寸保持相同。

words.note: 較正式、技術性較強，常見於設計、工程、醫療、產品描述等。
words.example: The update changes the visual appearance of the interface.
words.exampleZh: 這次更新改變了介面的視覺外觀。

exercises.original: The software update changes the appearance of the interface.
exercises.zh: 軟件更新改變了介面的視覺外觀。

options.explanation: 技術／設計語境中最自然。

exercises.original: The treatment improved the appearance of the scar.
exercises.zh: 治療改善了疤痕的視覺外觀。

exercises.original: The material has a smooth, metallic appearance.
exercises.zh: 這種材料具有平滑、金屬感的視覺外觀。

words.note: 當 appearance 不只是外形，而是顏色、字體、版面、造型等整體風格時，visual style 很接近。
words.example: The website now has a cleaner visual style.
words.exampleZh: 這個網站現在有更簡潔的視覺風格。

exercises.original: The website's appearance is clean and minimalist.
exercises.zh: 網站的視覺風格簡潔而極簡。

options.explanation: minimalist 描述的是整體風格。

exercises.original: The film has a distinctive appearance inspired by 1970s photography.
exercises.zh: 這部電影有受七十年代攝影啟發的獨特視覺風格。

exercises.original: The app's appearance is now more consistent across all screens.
exercises.zh: 這個應用程式在所有畫面的視覺風格現在更一致。

options.explanation: 一致性通常是風格層面的描述。

words.note: 當 appearance 指某物如何被整理、展示或呈現給別人看時，presentation 很接近。
words.example: The food's presentation was simple but attractive.
words.exampleZh: 食物的呈現方式簡單但吸引。

exercises.original: The appearance of the food was simple but elegant.
exercises.zh: 食物的呈現方式簡單但優雅。

options.explanation: 餐飲語境中常指擺盤與外在呈現。

exercises.original: The product's appearance was improved by new packaging.
exercises.zh: 新包裝改善了產品的外在呈現。

options.explanation: 包裝直接影響產品如何被展示。

exercises.original: The report's appearance was made more professional with clearer charts.
exercises.zh: 更清晰的圖表令報告的呈現更專業。

words.note: 可指事物的形狀、結構或呈現形式。比 appearance 稍偏「形態」而不只是表面視覺印象。
words.example: The sculpture has a simple geometric form.
words.exampleZh: 這件雕塑有簡單的幾何外形。

exercises.original: The appearance of the sculpture is unusually simple.
exercises.zh: 這件雕塑的形態異常簡潔。

options.explanation: 雕塑語境中常指外形與結構。

exercises.original: The building's appearance is long and narrow.
exercises.zh: 這座建築物的外形狹長。

exercises.original: The object has the appearance of a smooth oval.
exercises.zh: 這件物件呈平滑橢圓外形。

words.note: 較正式，指某物呈現出來的一個面貌或特徵；在部分語境可接近 appearance。
words.example: The renovation improved the overall aspect of the building.
words.exampleZh: 翻新改善了建築物的整體面貌。

exercises.original: The renovation improved the overall appearance of the building.
exercises.zh: 翻新改善了建築物的整體面貌。

options.explanation: 較正式地表示整體可見面貌。

exercises.original: One important part of the product's appearance is its colour scheme.
exercises.zh: 產品外觀的一個重要面向是其配色。

options.explanation: aspect 特別適合表示「其中一個面向」。

exercises.original: The external appearance of the house is traditional.
exercises.zh: 這所房子的外在面貌很傳統。

options.explanation: 較正式地描述外在面貌。

falseSynonyms.zh: appearance 只是看起來的樣子。 beauty 帶有正面審美判斷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The appearance changed. Its beauty impressed everyone.

falseSynonyms.zh: face 只指臉。 appearance 可以包括髮型、衣著、身形、整體造型。
image 常包括「別人怎樣看你」的社會印象。 appearance 可以只是純粹視覺外觀。
design 包括功能、結構、規劃。 appearance 只是其中可見的一面。
look 常指物件或整體視覺效果。 looks 常指人的外貌。
falseSynonyms.point: the look of the room her good looks

falseSynonyms.zh: visual appearance 更客觀。 visual style 強調一致的審美特徵。
presentation 常包括擺放、包裝、展示方式。
form 常強調形狀和結構。 appearance 更廣，包括顏色、表面、整體感覺。
